book_title: 不等式的秘密 第2卷
title: Poland MO 2007
stem_md:
设 $a, b, c, d$ 是正实数, 满足

$\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c} + \frac{1}{d} = 1$,

则

$8\sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} = \sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} \cdot \sum\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right) \geqslant 16$
solution_md:
由 Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式, 并注意条件 $\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c} + \frac{1}{d} = 1$, 则

$8\sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} = \sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} \cdot \sum\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right) \geqslant 16$

所以, 原不等式成立, 等号成立的条件是 $a = b = c = d = 1$.
original_text_md:
例 5.2.8(Poland MO 2007) 设 $a, b, c, d$ 是正实数, 满足

$\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c} + \frac{1}{d} = 1$,

则

$8\sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} = \sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} \cdot \sum\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right) \geqslant 16$

证明 由 Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式, 并注意条件 $\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} + \frac{1}{c} + \frac{1}{d} = 1$, 则

$8\sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} = \sum\frac{1}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}} \cdot \sum\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right) \geqslant 16$

所以, 原不等式成立, 等号成立的条件是 $a = b = c = d = 1$.
